function.name: read_file
function.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the repository and return its contents.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the repository root. Example: src/minicodex/model.py

function.name: apply_patch
function.description: Edit files by replacing exact blocks of text. Every edit is checked before any file is written: if one fails, nothing is written.

edits.description: The edits to apply, in any order.

path.description: Path to the file, relative to the repository root. Example: src/minicodex/model.py

old_text.description: The text to replace, copied from the file. It must appear exactly once -- include whole surrounding lines until it does. Do not write line numbers or diff markers.

new_text.description: What to put in its place.

function.name: run_shell
function.description: Run a shell command and return its combined stdout and stderr. The working directory persists across calls within one session (cd changes it for subsequent calls). Backgrounded commands (trailing '&') are not supported. Long-running or silent commands are killed after 30 seconds.
